Software Versions

Versions currently used by BGA framework:

  • Dojo Toolkit 1.15 - deprecated, avoid at all cost
  • PHP: 8.4
  • SQL: MySQL 5.7 (prod) - on studio 8.0
  • JS/CSS/HTML: limited by what minimization tools support: JS minimization
